---
title: "Basin-level municipal water withdrawal data preparation"
---

# Objective
+ To prepare the basin-level municipal water withdrawal data for 2019. 
+ Specifically, I will allocate the country-level municipal water withdrawal volumes from Aquastat data to the 235 global river basins using the country $\times$ basin level municipal water withdrawal data from GCAM.

# Main Data

+ `nonirrigation_withdrawal.csv` + Each row corresponds to the combination of ISO country and GCAM basin. So, the same basin can appear multiple countries. 
  + we will use column `Municipal` 

```{r}
#| label: load-data

# Load the country-basin correspondence data
tbl_basin_to_country <- fread(here("Data/Raw/gcam/water/basin_to_country_mapping.csv"))

# Load the Aquastat municipal water withdrawal data
aquastat_municipal_withdrawal <- 
  fread(here("Data/Raw/aquastat/AQUASTAT_water_withdrawal_by_sector_18_22.csv")) %>%
  .[Variable == "Municipal water withdrawal" & Year == 2019]

# Load the nonirrigation withdrawal data
nonirrigation_withdrawal <- fread(here("Data/Raw/gcam/water/nonirrigation_withdrawal.csv"))

```
